# FindMyJobs

> FindMyJobs lists verified IT, Non-IT and Banking jobs in India with full details and direct application links or contact numbers. Access is a one-time payment per category.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://findmyjobs.in/): Overview of the platform
- [Pricing](https://findmyjobs.in/pricing): Category access plans
- [IT Jobs](https://findmyjobs.in/jobs/it): IT job listings
- [Non-IT Jobs](https://findmyjobs.in/jobs/non-it): Non-IT job listings
- [Banking Jobs](https://findmyjobs.in/jobs/banking): Banking job listings
- [About](https://findmyjobs.in/about): Who we are
